## Professional Summary

I am an IT infrastructure professional specialising in Microsoft environments, based in Lamongan, East Java, Indonesia. My background combines Microsoft infrastructure and hands-on system administration with supporting backend development, which means I understand both the application layer and the environment it runs on. I have worked as a Technical Consultant, a System Administrator, and a backend developer - often as the person clients and colleagues turn to when something breaks and the cause is not obvious.

My strongest skill is troubleshooting and root cause analysis. I prefer to find out why an issue happened rather than apply a temporary fix, and I document the result so it does not come back. I work carefully, communicate clearly, and take ownership of the systems I am responsible for - including a period as the sole IT person for a hospital environment, where reliability was not optional.

I am open to international opportunities, including remote roles and relocation to the GCC region (Kuwait, Saudi Arabia, UAE), Japan, Malaysia, Singapore, and other markets. I adapt quickly to new environments, tools, and working cultures.

## Projects

### Windows Server Hardening Script
A PowerShell toolkit that applies a baseline security configuration to Windows Server hosts: account and audit policies, SMB signing, and unnecessary service reduction. Idempotent, and logs every change for audit purposes.

**Technologies:** PowerShell, Windows Server, Group Policy
**Repository:** https://github.com/therealsatria
